items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: An old friend of mine from Princeton, Bill Priestly

ctx.x: That seems an odd note to put on the bottom of a guitar.

Yeah. An old friend of mine from Princeton, Bill Priestly, an architect from — a very good architect — from Chicago, had one, a seven string, in 1929, an old Martin, he just put an extra peg up there and put another string on.
Did you come from a musical family? Because I know your family now is pretty darned musical.
